profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, trading as IBM. Its website describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises with modular deployment. The site notes IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and states that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, saving thousands of manual hours.

The company's AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation; IBM watsonx.governance, which provides AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and is named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant (June 2026); and IBM watsonx, an enterprise AI platform that includes watsonx.governance for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection, and is model-agnostic. The OpenPages site also describes an OpenPages MCP Server for securely enabling AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects, and integration with watsonx.ai or third-party or custom models through an API-based architecture.

IBM has 448 New York legal exposures. Its SEC filings show CIK 0000051143, with a 10-K for the year ended 2025-12-31 reporting revenue of 67535000000 USD.
